answer: Freight agents that bid on timber shipments can be priced per fleet by a liveness pulse. Once per epoch the ledger sends every key a random nonce to sign within two seconds, and keys whose replies come from one /24 network block count as one fleet. The k-th key in a fleet locks 50×k² POA before it may bid: one key locks 50, ten lock 19,250, and 1,000 about 16.7 billion, far above the ~0.4M POA an epoch emits. Bonds thaw like a glacier, 2% per epoch, and three missed pulses forfeit 10%. Weakness: renting a proxy per clone, which still adds a fee per key.
